cleaned_text:
COUNTY CHIEF CONSTABLE'S OFFICE,
CASTLE HILL,
CAMBRIDGE.

12th April, 1935.

TELEPHONIC ADDRESS:
WEBB, CAMBRIDGE 3451.

Dear Sir Vernon,

In reply to your letter of 11th instant, PF. 43817/D.S.9.a., I enclose registration card of Alexis Samuel Finkelstein for your perusal as desired. Please cause card to be returned to me in due course.

Yours faithfully,

[signature]
Chief Constable of Cambridgeshire.

Colonel Sir V.G.W. Kell,
Box No. 500,
Parliament Street, B.O.,
London, S.W.1.

COUNTY CONSTABLE'S OFFICE,
CASTLE HILL,
CAMBRIDGE.

April 12th, 1935.

TELEPHONE NUMBER:
WEBB, CAMBRIDGE 3451.

Dear Mr. Vernon,

In response to your letter dated April 11th, PF. 43817/D.S.9.a., I am enclosing the registration card for Alexis Samuel Finkelstein for your review, as you requested. Please arrange for the card to be returned to me at your convenience.

Yours sincerely,

[signature]
Chief Constable of Cambridgeshire.

Colonel Sir V.G.W. Kell,
Box No. 500,
Parliament Street, B.O.,
London, S.W.1.
